budget_rule: Each budget is a hard per-arm deadline in allocated GPU-seconds for the identical complete workload. Stop at deadline, mark no completed outcome, retain censoring and elapsed cost; never treat partial option coverage as scientific success. No path truncation, restart aggregation, or selecting best of multiple estimates. Ten pairs per cell; no pooling cells to evade deadline.

confidence_rule.scientific: Accept fixed-realization equivalence only if every exact output comparison and both anchors pass in every completed pair at all budgets. Any failure rejects; incomplete or censored pairs cannot establish equivalence. No nonsignificance-to-equivalence inference.
confidence_rule.success: All scientific checks pass; no censored pairs; lower simultaneous speedup bound exceeds 1.05 at all sealed budgets. Report every cell regardless of outcome; no optional stopping.
confidence_rule.timing: For each method/budget, compute paired log(T_baseline/T_candidate) on all 10 complete pairs. Two-sided Student-t CI for mean log ratio, exponentiated; Bonferroni family confidence 95% across 3 methods x 3 budgets, each interval confidence 1-0.05/9 with 9 degrees of freedom. Report geometric mean speedup. Normal independent pair-log errors are a prospective assumption; evident dependence or invalid timing yields inconclusive result, no replacement analysis.

equal_outcome_target: Complete all 8192 European call prices using 262144 paths per option, fixed host inputs and original logical cuRAND streams, float arithmetic and per-option reduction order. Exact fixed-realization outputs equal matched baseline, unrounded average reserve >1.0, Test passed and exit 0. If baseline fails anchors, no candidate success claim; report failed target.

equivalence_metrics.role: Mandatory scientific acceptance anchor, not a baseline equivalence margin. Use unrounded reserve or upstream verdict at printed boundary.

equivalence_metrics.comparison: Test passed == 1 and exit status == 0; exact agreement with baseline
equivalence_metrics.role: Mandatory acceptance; same reserve predicate, not independent evidence.

equivalence_metrics.comparison: Exact equality of every option price and confidence width, aggregate unrounded reserve, L1, verdict and exit status against matched baseline
equivalence_metrics.role: Conservative protocol identity requirement, not a published numeric price/L1 tolerance. Preserve random draws and arithmetic order. Exact identity is sufficient for unchanged scientific output on this fixed workload only.
equivalence_metrics.source: intake/baseline.json published float configuration; intake/data.json fixed generator; intake/anchors.json zero-tolerance verdict requirement

equivalence_metrics.quantity: L1 scientific accuracy margin or population stochastic equivalence margin
equivalence_metrics.role: Unavailable. Record L1 descriptively. Do not infer a margin from method outputs, lack of significance, reserve acceptance, or timing profile. Broader equivalence claims blocked pending new sealed run with independent margin and power basis.

evaluation_inputs.identity_rule: Use pinned upstream generation in original order and one frozen host environment. Preserve original option indices and logical cuRAND initialization. Archive generated input and baseline output hashes at evaluation; no hashes currently available. A grid or libc change is a different input realization and requires a new seal.
evaluation_inputs.scale_rule: Fixed 8192-option case only. Disable adaptive expansion/doubling proposed in brief: changing options or paths requires new sealed run. Profile does not identify which scale was timed, so its duration cannot calibrate this workload.

gate_status: No gate scripts named by prompt or supplied intake; none executed.

hardware_cost_basis.accounting: One exclusively allocated GPU multiplied by end-to-end wall seconds. Host work remains included in wall time; host model/count and CPU-seconds recorded separately, no dollar conversion. No multi-device work.
hardware_cost_basis.budget_unit: allocated GPU-seconds per arm per timed attempt
hardware_cost_basis.environment_rule: Bind both arms to same physical GPU, host, toolkit, driver patch, libc, original logical grid and clock/power policy within paired evaluation. Record identities before execution. If original input/RNG identity cannot be maintained, abort this seal. No cross-hardware claim.
hardware_cost_basis.target_environment: Lambda Stack, Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA Toolkit 12.8, driver 570 compatible patch; exact GPU, driver patch, libc and grid unavailable in intake.

infeasible_methods.reason: Sealed brief fixes GPU count to one; no second GPU authorized or evidenced. Changing GPU count requires new sealed run.

Independent ensemble estimates change random draws, estimator and work count. No scientific tolerance supports that change; exact fixed-realization target excludes ensembles. Repeating baseline for timing is not an ensemble method.

fixed_seeds.device_seed: logical blockIdx.x + original gridDim.x * original device_id

paired_seed_tests.justification: Monte Carlo is stochastic in construction, but fixed generator state, float operations, logical grid and pinned environment define repeatable output. All methods must use identical per-option random draws and reduction order; resharding cannot reseed by new worker or batch ID. Exact full-output comparison tests this fixed realization. Five repeated identical seeds are not five independent scientific samples.
paired_seed_tests.limitation: No supplied independent stochastic seeds, variance estimates or defensible nonzero margins support a powered population equivalence test. Claims across seeds or hardware are prohibited.
paired_seed_tests.test: Compare baseline and candidate for every timing pair and every option; any mismatch rejects fixed-realization equivalence. If deterministic replay cannot be established, mark method non-equivalent/unavailable; do not substitute a significance test.
paired_seed_tests.type: Deterministic paired replay of a fixed stochastic realization; stochastic population equivalence not applicable to this narrow target

protocol_status: Prospective seal; no method code or workloads executed. Feasibility is conditional on preserving fixed logical random streams and per-option arithmetic. Performance intervals are assumptions, not measured gains.

sample_sizes.fixed_realization_equivalence: Exhaustive census of all 8192 paired option outputs; exact identity, no sampling error for this finite target. Statistical power calculation not applicable.
sample_sizes.powered_population_equivalence_status: Unavailable: no independent variance estimate or scientifically sourced nonzero margin. No finite sample establishes zero-margin stochastic population equivalence. Do not claim powered population equivalence.

scheduling_order.protocol: Construct all 90 method-budget-pair blocks in fixed menu order, ascending budget, ascending pair index. Shuffle blocks once using Python 3 random.Random(20261026).shuffle. Within each cell, form five AB and five BA labels, shuffle using same generator after block shuffle, assign to ascending pair indices. A=baseline, B=candidate. Run arms consecutively with synchronization and no competing GPU workloads. Record actual order, failures and deviations; no reruns selected by results.

seal_policy: Scope, tolerances, inputs, RNG mapping, compute budgets, schedule, timing scope, methods or analysis changes require a new sealed run before method evaluation.

splits.held_out: All 8192 generated options; reserved for sealed evaluation. No method selection or tuning using these outputs. No external dataset or learning split applies.
splits.tuning: No separately evidenced tuning corpus; no output-based tuning within this seal.

amdahl.reason: Recorded baseline_process fraction is not a measured parallel fraction. No timed input-parallel, transfer, kernel or overlap fraction and no worker speed/cost evidence. Do not assign baseline_process fraction to p. One GPU does not establish multiple equivalent workers. Bounds and overhead-adjusted numerical predictions unavailable.

timing_scope.overheads: Charge all method-specific launches, transfer, batching, scheduling, pipeline fill/drain, synchronization and merge overhead to primary interval and GPU allocation budget.
timing_scope.primary: Synchronized monotonic wall interval from baseline/candidate process launch through successful output finalization and validation; include initialization, launch, preprocessing, H2D, pricing, D2H, waiting, CPU merge/finalization and validation. Exclude compilation and harness-only telemetry.
timing_scope.secondary: Record upstream streamed Total time (ms.) separately with intake/EXECUTION.json scope. Never compare secondary timer to primary timer.

warmup: Per method and budget, run exactly two untimed baseline/candidate warmup pairs in AB then BA order on same full configuration, synchronizing completion. Warmup excluded from timing inference and per-attempt budgets; separately report its allocated GPU cost. Use no output-based adaptation. Failure or timeout marks cell unavailable.
